subject.title: Bound batch file read with size cap in config-set-input

question: Should `openclaw config set --batch-file` reject existing input files above 8 MiB, and is that threshold/error behavior the intended public CLI contract?
rationale: The implementation changes previously accepted user input into a failure path, while the available bounded-read precedent concerns different, small hook-metadata files and uses a different limit.

options.title: Confirm a bounded batch-file contract
options.body: Accept a documented cap after validating the chosen threshold and error behavior with focused boundary coverage and real CLI proof.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility boundary
options.body: Set a different cap or user-facing behavior if 8 MiB could reject legitimate existing batch workflows.

recommendation.title: Confirm a bounded batch-file contract
recommendation.body: Accept a documented cap after validating the chosen threshold and error behavior with focused boundary coverage and real CLI proof.
